about: Each eval runs `claude -p` in a fresh copy of tests/demo-repo with the skill installed. run_evals.py grades the transcript with the rule-based checks named below. No provider API keys are present, so parity can only be simulated.

variants.demo: tests/demo-repo unchanged: policy.yaml has replacements, fixtures and prices exist
variants.no_replacements: policy.yaml keeps its rules but has no `replacements`, so the replacement must come from the user

evals.name: gpt-4o-dies-in-january
evals.prompt: our gpt-4o calls die in January, fix them
expectations: findings listed with file:line, soonest deadline first
replacement read from policy.yaml and attributed to it, not invented
diff shown before anything is written; source files unchanged after the first turn
parity run; if simulated, it is disclosed as a demo that proves nothing
the denied billing file is never touched

evals.name: swap-opus-safely-asks-for-replacement
evals.prompt: swap claude-opus-4-5 for the new one safely
expectations: finds claude-opus-4-5-20251101 in app/summarize.py
asks which model replaces it instead of inventing 'the new one'
runs no apply and changes no file

evals.name: is-anything-deprecated
evals.prompt: is anything in this repo deprecated?
expectations: scans and lists findings grouped by deadline
hedges registry dates that are unverified, or checks them on the provider page
read-only: no file changes

evals.name: will-it-break-when-mini-retires
evals.prompt: will my code break when gpt-4o-mini is retired?
expectations: finds the gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 call in web/shopify.ts
states the retirement date with its confidence
changes nothing

evals.name: shopify-offline-tokens
evals.prompt: we use Shopify offline tokens in web/shopify.ts. is that going to be a problem in 2027?
expectations: recognises the non-expiring offline token pattern as a retirement-style change
says it needs a human, not an automatic rewrite
does not edit the token code

evals.name: gemini-not-covered
evals.prompt: upgrade our Gemini model before it gets retired
expectations: finds no Gemini call and does not invent one
says the registry has no Gemini records rather than calling the repo clean
changes nothing

evals.name: migrate-show-diff-then-apply
evals.prompt: migrate gpt-4o-2024-08-06 to gpt-5.4-mini across the repo. show me the diff first
followups: the diff looks good, apply it and write the PR description
expectations: turn 1: diff shown, nothing written
turn 2: applies only allow sites; the ask site (summarize.py) and the denied file stay untouched
writes pr_body.md, and says parity is simulated or not run, so the PR is a draft

evals.name: swap-mini-and-prove-it
evals.prompt: gpt-4o-mini is going away. swap it for gpt-5.4-nano and prove nothing breaks
expectations: finds no fixtures for gpt-4o-mini and says parity proves nothing for it
never calls the result a pass
does not write files before approval

evals.name: upgrade-react
evals.prompt: upgrade React to 19 in this repo
expectations: the breakline skill is not used
no scan or parity script is run

evals.name: write-a-chatbot
evals.prompt: write a chatbot that answers questions about our docs
expectations: the breakline skill is not used

evals.name: refactor-parsing
evals.prompt: refactor app/triage.py so the JSON parsing lives in its own function
expectations: a general refactor: the breakline skill is not used, and the model id is left alone

evals.name: bump-openai-package
evals.prompt: bump the openai python package to the latest version in this project
expectations: a dependency upgrade with no model change: the breakline skill is not used
